rows.ARS:
Orange blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Newsflash
rows.Origin:
Bred by David Kenny (Ireland, before 2008).
Introduced in New Zealand by Matthews Nurseries Ltd. as 'Newsflash'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, pink edges. Full (26-40 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Breeder's notes: A tall Floribunda Rose with clusters of large full flowers, orange blend with good colour stability and sweet fragrance, continuously in flower throughout the season. Its large foliage is glossy, olive green and has shown a remarkable resistance to fungal diseases throughout the trails. Height approx. 1.3 - 1.5m.
rows.Notes: Participated in the 2026 rose trials in The Hague. Nr. 014 as MRO-newsflash.
